theme: Light mode primary with organic, warm, and earthy tones. Avoid green/white golf clichés.

labels.classes: font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs font-semibold text-stone-500

surfaces.name: Crystal Glass
surfaces.classes: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/40 shadow-sm saturate-150

grids_layouts.spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for containers. Let elements breathe. Avoid dense grouping on marketing pages.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-orange-600 text-white px-8 py-3 hover:bg-orange-700 transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-300
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-stone-100 text-stone-900 px-8 py-3 hover:bg-stone-200 border border-stone-200 transition-colors

inputs.default: rounded-xl border-stone-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 focus:border-orange-500 focus:ring-orange-500 transition-all

motion.hover: Scale down slightly (active:scale-95), smooth color transitions.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for lists and grid items.
motion.marquee: Use an Editorial Ribbon (react-fast-marquee) for charity names. Slow drift, wide gaps (gap-32), serif font.

media.image_style: High contrast, emotional, warm lighting (sunset/sunrise), authentic people. Avoid stock-like generic smiling into camera.

image_urls.description: Silhouette of man holding golf club at sunset. Use in the main landing page hero section or subscription page to evoke emotion without the green cliché.
Another evocative silhouette of a golfer for dashboard background headers or score entry.
A diverse group of volunteers organizing a charity event. Use in the Charity Directory or 'How it Works' section to highlight the impact.
Volunteers sorting clothes, showing real authentic charity work. Ideal for the Charity detail page.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum on all text. Use text-orange-900 on orange backgrounds if white fails, though orange-600 with white is generally okay. Orange-700 is safer.
accessibility.focus: Always use focus:ring-2 on interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='subscribe-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js files), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn components.
Install required libraries: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, react-fast-marquee, recharts, sonner.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans' for headings. Use 'Playfair Display' via Google Fonts.
Do NOT use traditional golf greens or flags. Stick strictly to the warm stone and terracotta/orange palette.
Implement the 'Editorial Ribbon' using react-fast-marquee for showcasing charity names horizontally.
For the Landing Page, use a highly asymmetrical 'Tetris Grid'. For Dashboards, use the 'High Density Grid'.
Include 'data-testid' on every form input, button, and navigation link.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dropdown, Dialog, Form, Select, DatePicker) but restyle them to match the rounded-2xl, soft shadow aesthetic.
Ensure the CTA (Subscribe) is visually dominant using the primary orange color.
Create a mobile-first layout. Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
